Title: BPEL.BPEL.plink_get_option (
Description:
BPEL.BPEL.plink_get_option This function can be used to retrieve the options assigned to a
	    particular partner link.
	    These options are used to configure various Web Service
	    protocols (see Protocol Support section in BPEL reference chapter).

	    For available options see plink_set_option() function.
BPEL.BPEL.plink_get_option
plink_set_option()
